# Microsoft Authentication Library

The two JavaScript bundles and LICENSE.txt are unmodified files from the official
`@azure/msal-browser` npm package, version 5.25.1, published by Microsoft.

- Source: https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@azure/msal-browser/-/msal-browser-5.25.1.tgz
- Registry archive integrity: sha512-NDW2/bz2Pz71EJAlhSw+jg1kpRIWtrzj0gCzcHuG1u7iLvSOHpUc5lICkDA9x0bbeityxTneiunSBluvS+/y4w==
- msal-browser-5.25.1.min.js SHA-256: 56a548eae945c2479adf61d969140999e9f602ff627694cc0692346890556f52
- msal-redirect-bridge-5.25.1.min.js SHA-256: bd15092349b2e93ef363cdf60eaf881c62d0ad5557f98853e61231a8dc0f8269

Browser credentials remain in memory. The app uses popup sign-in with a dedicated
same-origin redirect page. These bundles do not contain client secrets or workbook data.
